approved.criterion: agreed beforehand: arm overlay visually aligned, and the native-depth camera correction <= 5 mm and <= 1 deg
approved.outcome: overlay judged aligned by the user; correction 4.33 mm / 0.58 deg, not applied

camera.mount: original Tianji head bracket, unmodified (user-confirmed); head fixed

convention: T_A_B maps coordinates in frame B into frame A; optical frames are x right, y down, z forward

applies_to.use: head fixed, static use; image-to-robot time synchronisation not covered

method.description: Composition of published geometry, no fitting: T_base_color = T_base_head * T_head_link * T_link_color.

Head depth_Link<-d435_link.source: Intel realsense-ros 4.58.4 _d435.urdf.xacro: d435_link at the depth origin, 17.5 mm from the case centre along the long axis and 4.3 mm behind the front glass; case orientation from registering Intel d435.dae to the vendor mesh "Head depth_Link.STL" (median surface gap 0.4-0.6 mm; front face = link y=0, outward -y)

d435_link<-d435_color_optical_frame.summary: colour lens 15.04 mm along +y of d435_link (0.4 mm along z), rotated 0.63 deg relative to the depth origin

intrinsics.source: factory CameraInfo, color 848x480: fx 603.646, fy 603.362, cx 430.930, cy 245.467, plumb_bob, D=0
intrinsics.check: 19 hand-held checkerboard views (DFOPTIX Q12-290-20, 11x8 inner corners, 20 mm), all 88 corners detected; per-view IPPE PnP RMS with factory K: 11 views 0.16-0.30 px (board in the upper/central image, 0.56-0.73 m), 8 views 0.42-1.14 px (mostly lower half or nearer, 0.51-0.61 m), largest single-corner error 3.0 px; corners covered x 177-713 / 848 px and y 18-457 / 480 px (left third and image corners not covered). A diagnostic distortion refit from the other views lowered the held-out mean RMS from 0.44 to 0.29 px but was not adopted because coverage was insufficient. Decision by the user: use factory intrinsics.

method.rounding_note: The arm check ran on the same chain with the driver TF rounded to 4-5 decimals; the exact composition recorded here differs from it by 0.007 mm / 0.005 deg.

fk_consistency.compared: vendor URDF FK (robot_perception.calibration.urdf_fk) vs Tianji libKine (wuji-hand-teleop tianji_kinematics, ccs_m6.MvKDCfg)
fk_consistency.flange: SDK flange = URDF TCP_Link (JointTCP, 95 mm from Link7); teleop TCP = flange + 70 mm along flange +Z

limitations: Validated on two static poses (home, and a second pose at 21:02); in both the arms lie near the left/right image edges and the image centre is not covered.
No independent metrological reference; agreement with the arm model is at the few-mm level.

In both checks the measured arm surface lies about 3-4 mm closer to the camera than the model on both arms (signed means +2.6 to +4.4 mm; vendor STL normals verified outward), and both fitted corrections include a forward translation along the optical axis (2.3 mm and 4.3 mm) consistent with that offset; this may be D435 depth bias or covers/cables thicker than CAD and cannot be separated from a camera offset along the optical axis with this method.
Depth unit 0.001 m taken from the realsense-ros 16UC1 convention, not measured independently.
Viewing angle to the table: 25.3 deg predicted vs 22.6 deg measured; the arm check does not support a camera error of this size; table/base parallelism unverified.
Re-check after any change of head, bracket, camera, URDF or driver; time synchronisation not validated.
